# `producers/self-monitor.ts`

## Overview

This module implements a self-monitoring producer that reads Hive's own [pino](https://github.com/pinojs/pino) logs from an in-memory log buffer to detect recurring errors and automatically create investigation tasks. `SelfMonitorProducer` is a global producer hardcoded to the Hive self-repo.

---

## Classes

### `SelfMonitorProducer`

```ts
import { SelfMonitorProducer } from '...'
```

Reads Hive's own pino logs (from the in-memory log buffer) to detect recurring errors and create investigation tasks.

> **Note:** This is a global producer — hardcoded to the Hive self-repo.

#### Methods

##### `run`

```ts
async run(ctx: ProducerContext): Promise<ProducerResult>
```

Executes the self-monitoring producer logic. Processes the in-memory log buffer to identify recurring errors and returns a result describing any investigation tasks that were created.

**Parameters:**

| Name  | Type              | Description                                      |
|-------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `ctx` | `ProducerContext` | The shared producer context provided by the Hive runtime. |

**Returns:** `Promise<ProducerResult>` — Resolves with the result of the producer run, including any tasks generated from detected log errors.
